config.aggregation: equal ordered guide construct weights within infection, then equal infection weights; orientations and technical reads are not biological replicates
config.coverage: whole-library filtering before gene selection; mean across infections of each guide's within-position median T0 count must exceed 35 in BOTH positions; both construct T0 counts must exceed 50; common construct panel across infections; at least two distinct ordered guide constructs per canonical pair
config.distribution: raw counts, derived numeric banks and model assets local only; source rights remain separate
config.environment_deviation: T0-only coverage replaces author's endpoint-count guide filter, declared before scoring to avoid selecting on depletion; not exact published-score reproduction
config.failure: no rescue tuning, no retraining, no primary-panel expansion; evaluate assay-shift diagnostics and identify a falsifiable next hypothesis only
config.independence: four cohorts from two later studies with two independently transduced infections each; shared lab lineage, not independent laboratories
config.metrics: MSE primary on mean of two infection gamma targets; MAE/bias/Pearson and each infection separately; replicate disagreement descriptive only
config.missing_counts: Blank required T0/reference counts are unavailable, never zero-imputed; exclude incomplete constructs before normalization; record exclusions and possible dropout bias.
config.model: unchanged validation-selected K562 independent completion; original singles and coefficients; no external fitting or normalization regression
config.normalization: add 10 to counts, log2 reference endpoint/T0, subtract surviving negative-negative median per infection, divide author reference cumulative doublings; sequencing fraction normalization cancels after control centering
config.objective: zero-shot K562 untreated/DMSO measured growth gamma source transfer
config.other_strata: original test previously scored; original validation selection-exposed; original train repeatability only
config.primary_population: distinct supported-gene pairs absent from entire original eligible bank; minimum 50 pairs and 10 genes per cohort
config.secondary: external measured single sum and minimum, extra-information assay-shift diagnostic only, no fitted calibration
config.success: all four cohorts qualify; in every cohort completion mean-target MSE at least 2% below frozen main effects, lower MSE in each infection, gene-resampling upper 95% loss-difference bound below zero, and no mean-target loss to other frozen simple baselines
config.uncertainty: 2000 pair-resampling and gene-resampling draws seed 20261020; resample unique genes with replacement and edge weight multiplicity(a)*multiplicity(b); discard zero-total draws and record actual count; conditional on measured cultures, not biological-population intervals

freeze.baseline_information: unchanged original singles and calibrated reference coefficients; no external pair labels or singles used to fit
freeze.purpose: pre-external-scoring freeze; existing K562 predictor without refitting or external single replacement
freeze.restrictions: validation pair labels influenced checkpoint selection; original-test pairs were previously scored; train pairs only repeatability
